text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Special Week came by in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Would you like to enjoy summer to the fullest together tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When I was a kid, I didn't really
play at the beach much during summer.
Because Hokkaido was so cool.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So this year, I'm gonna enjoy summer to the fullest! After all,
if you don't make the most of it, you can't get into the summer spirit.
How about you make the most of it too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ehehe... Actually, there was a magazine
feature called "Make the Most of Summer at the Beach This Year!"
and I thought it looked pretty nice...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, leave it to me!
I'll enjoy it to the fullest just like it said!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the next day.
First, I went for a walk along the beach with Special Week, but—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-It's so fun! We're just taking a walk, but
it's making my heart race, or something!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *Thump-thump*...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The magazine said, 'Just walking side by side
will make you feel like dancing!☆' and yet...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, next time, next time! Next time we'll enjoy
the scenery together! That should do the trick!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Seagulls, seagulls... a yacht...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Somehow, I feel like I'm not enjoying this
as much as the magazine made it out to be...
choice_data_list: Maybe the magazine's method just doesn't suit your taste?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: To your liking...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! That might be it!
choice_data_list: Why not do what you find fun?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Something I find fun...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's go grab something to eat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ As expected, eating yakisoba
while looking at the sea really is the best~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is it! Exactly this!
Doing what you want—I love this feeling!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Summer is so fun!
It makes me feel like yelling 'Yay!!'"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I get it now!
So this is what it means to fully enjoy oneself~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are you having fun too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'm having fun because you're having fun.
I'm having fun because you're enjoying yourself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is that so~... Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then next, I'd like to try something you recommend
that you think I would enjoy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Do you have any recommendations?!
choice_data_list: Wanna build a sandcastle or something?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Speaking of beautiful seashells...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, clam digging!
Like asari clams and hamaguri clams!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Is it okay to just take those without asking, though?
I'll go check real quick!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only intended to look for seashells,
but it seems I ended up giving them the wrong impression...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I went and asked!
They said it's fine as long as we don't go out offshore to catch them!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna dig with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho! Heave-ho!
Ah! Look, there's a crab!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us kept searching for edible shellfish—
innocently enjoying summer to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A sandcastle! It's like a sand version of the Snow Festival!
That certainly sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we're taking the time to make one,
I'd rather make a carrot than a castle!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of making it and sending a picture to my mom!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! All right, I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Special Week faced the challenge
full of enthusiasm, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It's no gooood... No matter how hard I try,
the thin bottom part keeps getting crushed..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I should've gone with a castle after all..."
choice_data_list: Don't you think we need a stable foundation?
Don't we need a stable foundation?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A base to keep the carrot stable...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I get it! A "Carrot Hamburg Steak"!!
If we stabilize it with the patty, it might not fall apart!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
All right, time to give it everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Special Week crafted
a magnificent sand sculpture of a carrot hamburg steak.
